units.summary: For KindRecord items, loadMetadata now ignores any error from getRecord and returns metadata with nil error. Items are tracked even when the inventory lookup fails, with a partially filled record (key set, no owner).

issues.title: All lookup errors swallowed, including transient ones, leaving owner empty
issues.failure_scenario: Inventory times out or connection fails on first Track: the item is tracked with an empty Owner. The failure is cached for 5 minutes, so later lookups also fail, and the item may keep the wrong owner and be treated as non-system.

units.headline: Record lookup errors are now ignored when loading item metadata
units.reason: Error handling changed: failures previously propagated and now silently produce degraded metadata.
focus: Whether transient errors (timeouts, connection failures) should also fall back rather than only FORBIDDEN replies
Callers relying on Owner being set or on the error to skip or retry the item
Whether the item's metadata is persisted or cached with the empty owner

units.summary: New tests cover error caching with TTL per key, success caching, isErrorReply with wrapped errors, and the loadMetadata fallback when lookup returns a reply error.
units.headline: Adds tests for inventory client error caching and loadMetadata fallback
